subject: dsa
title: Product of Array Except Self
summary: No division allowed. Sweep left filling each slot with the product of everything to its left, then sweep right multiplying in the product of everything to its right.
problem: Return res where res[i] is the product of every element of nums except nums[i], without using division.

steps.caption: Goal: res[i] = product of all of nums except nums[i], with no division. nums = [1,2,3,4]. Start res all 1s and fill it in two sweeps.
Left sweep: set res[i] to the product of everything LEFT of i. res[0] has nothing to its left, so it stays 1.
res[1] = product of the left part {1} = 1.
res[3] = product of {1, 2, 3} = 6. Left sweep done: res = [1, 1, 2, 6].
Right sweep: carry a running product R of everything to the RIGHT, starting R = 1. At i=3: res[3] x R = 6 x 1 = 6. Then fold in nums[3]=4, so R = 4.
i=2: res[2] x R = 2 x 4 = 8. Update R = 4 x nums[2] = 12.
i=1: res[1] x R = 1 x 12 = 12. Update R = 12 x nums[1] = 24.
i=0: res[0] x R = 1 x 24 = 24. Every slot now holds the product of the rest: [24, 12, 8, 6].
